'''Noira''' was a [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who eventually became the third [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]] of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she decided to target only one organization: the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. This resulted in a violent reprisal from [[Tyber Zann]] and culminated in the death of the Pirate Queen in a [[Battle between Ord Mantell and Genassa|large space battle]].<ref name="MotPQ" />
